name: add_chart_object
description:
Add a drawing object to the active chart. Returns objectId for later deletion.

IMPORTANT: All time values must be ISO 8601 UTC strings (e.g. '2024-01-15T10:00:00Z'). Two-point objects require BOTH a price AND a time for each point — a price alone is not enough to place the object on the chart.

object_type values and required parameters:
  horizontal_line       - price1 (or 'price') — no time needed
  vertical_line         - time1 (or 'time') — no price needed
  trend_line, ray, arrow_line - price1+time1, price2+time2; extend? (bool)
  equidistant_channel   - price1+time1, price2+time2
  rectangle, ellipse    - price1+time1, price2+time2; fill? (bool)
  triangle              - price1+time1, price2+time2, price3+time3; fill? (bool)
  fibonacci_retracement, fibonacci_fan, fibonacci_timezones - price1+time1, price2+time2
  fibonacci_expansion   - price1+time1, price2+time2, price3+time3
  gann_fan, gann_box, gann_square, gann_square_fixed - price1+time1, price2+time2
  andrews_pitchfork     - price1+time1, price2+time2, price3+time3
  risk_reward           - side (buy/sell), price1=entry, price2=stop_loss, price3=take_profit, time1=block_start (required), time2=block_end (optional, defaults to time1)
  text                  - price1+time1, text content
  Markers (price1+time1): up_arrow, down_arrow, circle, square, diamond, star, up_triangle, down_triangle

object_type.description: Type of drawing object (see tool description)

price1.description: First price point (also accepted as 'price'). For risk_reward: entry price.

time1.description: First time point ISO 8601 UTC (also accepted as 'time'). Required for all two-point objects and risk_reward.

price2.description: Second price point. For risk_reward: stop loss price.

time2.description: Second time point ISO 8601 UTC. For risk_reward: block end time (optional, defaults to time1).

price3.description: Third price point. For fibonacci_expansion/andrews_pitchfork/triangle: third anchor. For risk_reward: take profit price.

time3.description: Third time point ISO 8601 UTC (fibonacci_expansion, andrews_pitchfork, triangle).

extend.description: Extend to infinity for trend_line (default: false)

name: calculate_margin
description: Calculate the expected margin required to open a position for a given symbol and volume.

volume.description: Volume amount for margin calculation. `volume` is a positive decimal number. Its unit is defined by `volumeType`. Decimal/fractional values are allowed. Do not infer the unit from the numeric value. `volumeType` is required and must be either `lots` or `units`. `lots` means `volume` is expressed in lots and must be converted to units using the current symbol `lotSize`. `units` means `volume` is already expressed in units. If the user did not clearly specify lots or units, ask a clarification question before calling the tool. The requested volume must be resolved and validated against current symbol volume constraints before the operation. Read `lotSize`, `minVolume`, `maxVolume`, and `volumeStep` from get_symbol_details for the exact symbol. If `volumeType` is `lots`, compute `volumeInUnits = volume * lotSize`. If `volumeType` is `units`, use `volumeInUnits = volume`. `minVolume`, `maxVolume`, and `volumeStep` are always expressed in units. `volumeInUnits` must be within `[minVolume, maxVolume]` and must match the symbol's `volumeStep` grid. Use decimal-safe arithmetic. Do not round, clamp, snap, or otherwise change the requested volume silently.

volumeType.description: `volumeType` is required whenever `volume` is provided. If the user did not specify whether the amount is in lots or units, ask before calling the tool.

volume.description: Volume amount to close partially. `volume` is a positive decimal number. Its unit is defined by `volumeType`. Decimal/fractional values are allowed. Do not infer the unit from the numeric value. `volumeType` is required and must be either `lots` or `units`. `lots` means `volume` is expressed in lots and must be converted to units using the current symbol `lotSize`. `units` means `volume` is already expressed in units. If the user did not clearly specify lots or units, ask a clarification question before calling the tool. The requested volume must be resolved and validated against current symbol volume constraints before the operation. Read `lotSize`, `minVolume`, `maxVolume`, and `volumeStep` from get_symbol_details for the exact symbol. If `volumeType` is `lots`, compute `volumeInUnits = volume * lotSize`. If `volumeType` is `units`, use `volumeInUnits = volume`. `minVolume`, `maxVolume`, and `volumeStep` are always expressed in units. `volumeInUnits` must be within `[minVolume, maxVolume]` and must match the symbol's `volumeStep` grid. Use decimal-safe arithmetic. Do not round, clamp, snap, or otherwise change the requested volume silently. The resolved `volumeInUnits` must not exceed the position's current volume, which is also expressed in units. If the requested volume is invalid, do not retry with a guessed or automatically adjusted volume. Explain the valid constraints to the user and ask for a corrected volume. When suggesting alternatives, present them in the user's original `volumeType` and include the equivalent units value when useful.

volumeType.description: `volumeType` is required whenever `volume` is provided. If the user did not specify whether the amount is in lots or units, ask before calling the tool.

name: get_pending_orders
description: Get all pending orders with details: symbol, side, order type, volume (in units and lots), target price, current price, stop loss price (absolute) and pips, take profit price (absolute) and pips, expiration, label, and comment. All price fields are absolute prices; *Pips fields are distances in pips. `volumeInUnits` is the canonical volume; `volumeInLots = volumeInUnits / lotSize`.

name: get_positions
description: Get all open trading positions with details: symbol, side, volume (in units and lots), entry price, current price, pips, profit, swap, commission, stop loss price (absolute) and pips, take profit price (absolute) and pips, open time, label, and comment. All price fields are absolute prices; *Pips fields are distances in pips. `volumeInUnits` is the canonical volume; `volumeInLots = volumeInUnits / lotSize`.

name: get_order_history
description: Get closed trade history including symbol, side, volume, entry/close price, pips, profit, and timestamps. Returns trades currently loaded in the repository.

name: amend_order
description: Modify a pending order's entry price, volume, expiration, stop loss, or take profit.

orderId.description: The pending order ID to modify

entryPrice.description: New entry price. Omit to leave unchanged.

volume.description: New pending order volume amount. `volume` is a positive decimal number. Its unit is defined by `volumeType`. Decimal/fractional values are allowed. Do not infer the unit from the numeric value. `volumeType` is required and must be either `lots` or `units`. `lots` means `volume` is expressed in lots and must be converted to units using the current symbol `lotSize`. `units` means `volume` is already expressed in units. If the user did not clearly specify lots or units, ask a clarification question before calling the tool. The requested volume must be resolved and validated against current symbol volume constraints before the operation. Read `lotSize`, `minVolume`, `maxVolume`, and `volumeStep` from get_symbol_details for the exact symbol. If `volumeType` is `lots`, compute `volumeInUnits = volume * lotSize`. If `volumeType` is `units`, use `volumeInUnits = volume`. `minVolume`, `maxVolume`, and `volumeStep` are always expressed in units. `volumeInUnits` must be within `[minVolume, maxVolume]` and must match the symbol's `volumeStep` grid. Use decimal-safe arithmetic. Do not round, clamp, snap, or otherwise change the requested volume silently. Omit this field to leave the pending order volume unchanged. If the requested volume is invalid, do not retry with a guessed or automatically adjusted volume. Explain the valid constraints to the user and ask for a corrected volume. When suggesting alternatives, present them in the user's original `volumeType` and include the equivalent units value when useful.

volumeType.description: `volumeType` is required whenever `volume` is provided. If the user did not specify whether the amount is in lots or units, ask before calling the tool.

expiration.description: New expiration datetime (ISO 8601). Omit to leave unchanged; pass null to clear.

stopLossPips.description: New stop loss distance in pips. Omit to leave unchanged; pass null to clear.

takeProfitPips.description: New take profit distance in pips. Omit to leave unchanged; pass null to clear.

name: amend_position
description: Modify the stop loss and/or take profit of an open position (prices, not pips).

stopLoss.description: New stop loss price (absolute). Omit to leave unchanged; pass null to clear.

takeProfit.description: New take profit price (absolute). Omit to leave unchanged; pass null to clear.
